summary: Full backend + frontend test run for LORÉ v2 (object storage uploads, Gemini Nano Banana image gen, public characters, discover, cross-user public chat, new character fields). 29/30 backend tests pass. 1 real backend bug found in /api/chats/recent. Frontend works end-to-end: welcome, auth, discover, character form, profile, chat (send + typing indicator + reply + memory-saved toast), mobile layout.

critical.issue: Only returns characters owned by the user. Per spec it must also include public characters the user has chatted with (non-owned). Current query: db.characters.find({user_id: user.id}) — needs union with distinct character_ids from db.messages where user_id=user.id.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid="chat-memories-link"] did not navigate to memories (likely inside a collapsed/hover menu, not wired to onClick navigation, or requires opening the kebab/info menu first).

action_items: Fix /api/chats/recent: union owned characters AND characters the current user has sent messages to. Example: collect distinct character_ids from db.messages.find({user_id}), add any missing ones (usually public, viewable via _character_view) to the recent list ordered by last message time.
Verify chat-memories-link click navigates to /characters/{id}/memories (if it's inside a menu, ensure the menu opens on click and the link is keyboard/click accessible).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines — approaching split threshold; consider extracting storage/auth/characters/chat into modules.
maybe_generate_image errors are swallowed with warning only — OK per spec (best-effort), good.
IMAGE_TAG stripping works even when gen fails; correct.
No rate-limiting on /api/upload — 5MB cap is enforced after read(), acceptable for MVP but consider streaming check.
bcrypt+jwt flows correct, duplicate signup 400, bad login 401, /auth/me 401 all pass.
cross-user isolation correct for private chars (404) and public access works as intended.
Minor: /api/files/{path} returns 401 without token and 404 for unknown — both verified.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all core flows green; 1 minor nav link)

test_credentials: test@lore.app / testpass123 (existing seeded user, confirmed working).
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ users (User A, User B) + characters during pytest run. User A's test character is deleted at end of suite. User B retains 1 TEST_Private character + message history on User A's public character (since that character is kept for Elara Voss seed). No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid; only /api/chats/recent needs union with chatted characters. All 30 tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py are deterministic except the TestRecentChats.test_recent_includes_chatted_public which currently fails due to the real bug. Frontend data-testids are comprehensive (82 testids). AuthImage blob loading was not explicitly exercised but chat images are supported by the backend and user image_path round-trips correctly.

rca of the issue.bug: /api/chats/recent omits non-owned public characters the user has chatted with.
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) User A creates public character C. 2) User B logs in and POSTs a message to /api/characters/{C.id}/messages. 3) User B calls GET /api/chats/recent → response list does NOT include C (but it should).
rca of the issue.root_cause: Handler queries db.characters.find({user_id: current_user.id}) only; never inspects db.messages for character_ids the current user has interacted with.
rca of the issue.mitigation: In recent_chats: (a) fetch owned chars; (b) SELECT DISTINCT character_id FROM messages WHERE user_id=current_user.id; (c) for any id not in owned set, fetch via _character_view (owner-or-public) and append; (d) sort combined list by max(character.updated_at, last_message.created_at) desc.
